title: Three Weeks and One Short Cable
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：laptop　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 laptop 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 2004 the engineer ① repaired the laptop that no student in the studio would have recorded, and he said the repairing was the whole of the week. The ② laptop, meaning the machine itself and not the cable, ran three weeks and stayed unrecorded in the book; a laptop, he said, is the only thing in a studio that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ laptop in that studio had the same short cable beside it, and the ④ laptop at the far desk, meaning the file they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A laptop, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the engineer said the recording is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the laptop was the whole of the matter, meaning the link and not the machine. The ⑥ laptop, meaning the link and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; laptop, he said, is either something you repair or the only word that means both a machine and a link. He said the link is the part they remember.

By 2009 the ⑦ laptop had become a line in a ticket, and the ticket had become an argument about the short cable. The ⑧ laptop of the whole thing, the engineer wrote in May, was one studio and three weeks of recording; laptop, he said, is either the file at the far desk or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ laptop I remember is the machine recorded in the ticket, which closed in 2011 and is still recorded as the quietest in the studio. A ⑩ laptop, my mother said in 2013, is the only machine that improves by being recorded; every laptop, she said, is a link that has agreed to look like a machine. She said the link was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 笔记本电脑；便携机（指工作室里每一台旁边的那一台）
B. n. 笔记本电脑；便携机（指那台笔记本电脑本身，与线缆相对）
C. 固定搭配：repair the laptop 修理这台笔记本
D. n. 笔记本电脑；便携机（指留给孩子们拷走的那个文件那一台）
E. n. 联网之事（抽象总称，指一处工作室的笔记本之事）
F. n. 笔记本电脑；便携机（指工单里写到、被记载的的那一台）
G. n. 连接、门路（指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 门路（抽象总称，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: repaired the laptop that no student in the studio would have recorded
The laptop, meaning the machine itself and not the cable
the laptop at the far desk
the laptop was the whole of the matter
the laptop had become a line in a ticket
The laptop of the whole thing
A laptop, my mother said in 2013

answers.why: repair the laptop 意为“修理这台笔记本”，2004 年那位工程师把工作室里没有一位学生肯记载的一台笔记本做了一遍。
laptop 意为“笔记本电脑；便携机”，指那台笔记本电脑本身而不是线缆，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记载。
laptop 意为“笔记本电脑；便携机”，指工作室里每一台旁边的那一台，每一台旁边都有同一根短短的线缆。
laptop 意为“笔记本电脑；便携机”，指最远那张书桌留给孩子们拷走的那个文件那一台，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
laptop 意为“连接、门路”，指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这条连接就是那件事的全部。
laptop 意为“门路”，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西而不是那台笔记本电脑，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
laptop 意为“笔记本电脑；便携机”，指工单里写到、被记载的的那一台，到 2009 年这一台成了工单里的一行。
laptop 意为“联网之事”，工程师五月写道，整件事的笔记本之事是一处工作室和三个星期的记载。
laptop 意为“笔记本电脑；便携机”，我记得的是工单里记载过的那一台，2011 年修好了，至今仍被说成工作室里最安静的一台。
laptop 为抽象总称，母亲 2013 年说，笔记本是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的笔记本电脑。
